_help: MEMBERS. To add someone, copy one { ... } block, paste it after the last one, and put a comma between blocks (but NOT after the last one). name = gamer tag WITHOUT 'HAZE' (the site adds it). role = Leader, Co-Leader, Captain, Member, Recruit... (Leader/Founder/Owner get a glowing card). game = main game. avatar = optional picture path like images/avatars/rxven.jpg, or leave empty to show their initial.
